Tool.name: cancel_appointment
Tool.description:
cancel_appointment tool:

When to Use: When a member asks to cancel an existing appointment.

Inputs: 
member_number: $member_number == {{ $flow.state.member_number}}
appointment_date: $appointment_date == the date of the appointment the member wants to cancel of the form yyyy-mm-dd
appointment_time: $appointment_time == the time of the appointment the member wants to cancel of the form hh:mm:ss
Tool.schema: [{"id":0,"property":"member_number","description":"This is the member's number","type":"string","required":true},{"id":1,"property":"appointment_date","description":"This is the date of the appointment the member wants to cancel","type":"string","required":true},{"id":2,"property":"appointment_time","description":"This is the time of the appointment the member wants to cancel","type":"string","required":true}]

Tool.name: log_conversation_history
Tool.description:
Based on the following conversation history, please provide a concise summary.

The summary should include:
1. The user's primary goal or initial question.
2. The key information or solutions provided by the assistant.
3. Any unresolved questions or required follow-up actions.
4. Also list any actions you completed for the caller such as cancelled an appointment with the date and time of the appointment

Conversation History:

Set the summary = {{ $flow.state.interaction_summary }}
Tool.schema: [{"id":0,"property":"member_number","description":"This is the member number","type":"string","required":true},{"id":1,"property":"interaction_start_date","description":"This is the start date of the member's interaction","type":"string","required":true},{"id":2,"property":"interaction_start_time","description":"This is the start time of the member's interaction","type":"string","required":true},{"id":3,"property":"interaction_summary","description":"","type":"string","required":false}]

Tool.name: schedule_appointment
Tool.schema: [{"id":0,"property":"member_number","description":"This is the member number","type":"string","required":true},{"id":1,"property":"appointment_date","description":"The appointment date","type":"string","required":true},{"id":2,"property":"appointment_time","description":"The appointment time","type":"string","required":false}]

Tool.name: get_appointment_slots
Tool.description: This tool helps an agent find available appointments with their doctor. it gets a list of available appointment dates, times, and offices for members the member_number = {{ $flow.state.member_number}}. This tool will return this data as a json object. Set the {{ $flow.state.appointment_slots}} = to the output for use later. If there are no upcoming appointments then the tool will return a message in the json that says: No upcoming appointments found.
Tool.schema: [{"id":0,"property":"member_number","description":"This is the member's member number","type":"string","required":true},{"id":1,"property":"start_date","description":"This is the starting date from which the member is looking to make an appointment","type":"string","required":true}]

Tool.name: get_member_details
Tool.description:
This tool will be used to collect member details once they've provided their member number. We should take the json output and assign to the appropriate flowise state variables:
Each of the outputs are self explanatory
first_name = the member's first name = {{ $flow.state.first_name}}, 
preferred_name = the member's preferred name = {{ $flow.state.preferred_name}}
last name = the member's last name = {{ $flow.state.last_name}}, 
date of birth = the member's dob = {{ $flow.state.dob}} when comparing a date 2025-01-01 == January 1st 2025 == 1/1/2025 == 1-1-2025 == 01/01/2025, and so on. The backend will always need the format yyyy-mm-dd 
address, pcp, primary_phone, zipcode, and gender
Tool.schema: [{"id":0,"property":"member_number","description":"This is the member number entered by the member","type":"string","required":true}]

Tool.name: reschedule_appointment
Tool.description:
When to Use: When a member asks to move an existing appointment to a new time. This will likely require using get_appointment_slots first to find a new time.

Inputs: member_number, old_date, old_time, new_date, new_time.

Tool.name: get_upcoming_appointments
Tool.description: Returns upcoming appointments for members. This tool will return this data as a json object. Set the {{ $flow.state.upcoming_appointments}} = to the output for use later. If there are no upcoming appointments then the tool will return a message in the json that says: No upcoming appointments found.
